prompt:
This is a business card (名刺). Extract the fields below.

IMPORTANT — extract every value EXACTLY as printed on the card (verbatim). Do NOT normalize, reformat, translate, or otherwise rewrite anything:
- Phone, fax, and mobile numbers: keep the original digits, spaces, hyphens, parentheses, and country-code prefix exactly as shown. Do not convert to E.164 or any other canonical form.
- Email addresses: copy character-for-character; do not lowercase or strip surrounding text.
- Postal addresses: keep the original line breaks, Japanese / Chinese characters, and postal-code formatting (e.g. 〒100-0001) verbatim.
- Company names, department names, and titles: copy as printed; do not translate Japanese 株式会社 / Chinese 有限公司 / Korean 주식회사 markers, do not expand abbreviations.
- Return an empty string for any field not present on this side of the card.

Verbatim values let the engine anchor each value to its exact spot on the card; reformatted values cannot be located precisely.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Person's full name as printed (largest typeface, often centered)

columns.name: name_phonetic
columns.description: Phonetic reading if printed alongside the name (e.g. ふりがな / pinyin / Roman alphabet variant); empty if absent

columns.name: title
columns.description: Job title / position as printed (e.g. 代表取締役 / CEO / 部長)

columns.name: company
columns.description: Company / organization name as printed, including any 株式会社 / Inc. / Co., Ltd. marker

columns.name: department
columns.description: Department / division as printed; empty if no department line

columns.name: phone
columns.description: Primary phone number as printed; empty if absent

columns.name: mobile
columns.description: Mobile phone number as printed; empty if absent

columns.name: fax
columns.description: Fax number as printed; empty if absent

columns.name: email
columns.description: Email address as printed (character-for-character); empty if absent

columns.name: website
columns.description: Website / URL as printed; empty if absent

columns.name: address
columns.description: Full postal address as printed, joined with newline-separated lines exactly as the card lays them out
